install.introPrivat: Get Dialogbot Privat as an app on your phone: one tap from the home screen and a message when something happens.
install.introErhverv: Get Dialogbot as an app on your phone – one tap from the home screen to calls, bookings and inquiries.
install.hintIos: iPhone: via Share → Add to Home Screen
install.hintDesktop: Open this page on your phone to get the app.
install.manualAndroid: Tap the menu (⋮) at the top of the browser and choose “Add to Home screen” or “Install app”.
install.manualDesktop: Open {host}{path} on your phone and tap Download app there.
install.thenNotify: Then open the app from the home screen and tap “Turn on notifications”.
install.iosTitle: Getting the app on your iPhone
install.iosStep1: Tap Share at the bottom of Safari.
install.iosStep2: Choose “Add to Home Screen” and tap Add.
install.iosStep3: Open Dialogbot from the home screen.
install.iosStep3Privat: Open Dialogbot from the home screen and tap “Turn on notifications”.
install.iosNote: Apple does not let a page install itself – it takes these two taps.

pwa.offlinePrivat: You are offline – the page will show again when you are connected. Only your view is waiting – write again when the network is back.

pwa.pushTitle: Should I notify you on your phone?
pwa.pushTextErhverv: Even when the app is closed: new calls, bookings and messages for you. One notification, when it matters.
pwa.pushOn: Notifications are on for this device.

pwa.pushFailed: Notifications could not be turned on. Try again in a moment.
